item.title: The creative software industry has declared war on Adobe
item.description:
📝 All empires eventually fall, and it seems the creative software industry has collectively decided that Adobe’s time has come. One example that was announced this week is Autograph, motion design software akin to Adobe After Effects. When you pair these recent announcements with creative software that was already free, or at least subscription free, then you have an industry movement that should give Adobe something to worry about.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theverge.com/tech/913765/adobe-rivals-free-creative-software-app-updates

item.title: Airline worker arrested after sharing photos of bomb damage in WhatsApp group
item.description:

item.title: When moving fast, talking is the first thing to break
item.description:
